prompt: [controlled, curious, slightly eerie] If you flew close enough to a black hole, you could travel into the future. [calm, measured] You'd watch your clock tick for just one hour. [lower, unsettling] But back on Earth, years could be passing. [quiet, building dread] And when you finally returned, your friends would be old. [soft, haunting] Your family might already be gone. [steady, like a realisation] Because you didn't just travel through space. [eerie, landing it] You traveled through time.
prompt_note: The approved words, verbatim (production/NARRATION_LOCKED.txt). The bracket tags direct delivery (controlled, slightly eerie, increasingly unsettling) and are not spoken.
generated_once: One run of two variations (the connector default), 2 x 495.95 credits. No regeneration.

takes.why_not: slightly quicker read; 'time.' lands softer (-4.5 dB vs the median word) than in take 2 (-2.6 dB)

takes.asr_note: Whisper base.en: exact. Zipformer: 'travelled' for 'traveled' (spelling only).
takes.why: more controlled pacing with longer natural pauses; 'old.' is quiet (-7.4 dB vs the median word), which suits the brief's quiet, haunting turn; the final 'time.' lands firmer

edits: Six sentence gaps (measured below -45 dBFS) LENGTHENED: +0.25 s before 'You'd', +0.25 s before 'But', +0.30 s before 'And', +0.35 s before 'Your', +0.60 s before 'Because', +0.35 s before the final 'You' (2.10 s in all), each inserted as digital silence in the middle of a silent run with a 12 ms equal-power crossfade; plus a 0.15 s lead-in so the time-warp hit owns frame 0. Every word is used sample for sample: no time-stretch, no pitch or gain change. See tools/make_narration.py.
word_timing: local sherpa-onnx Zipformer token timestamps snapped to measured pause onsets, re-measured on the edited master (tools/align_zipformer.py -> audio/narration/master_zipformer.json)
